subject: Flamerus Rex
text: Flamerus Rex uses Twin Fang, Bone Missile, Rip Earth, and Sleep Powder, and is immune to poison and paralyzing.

evidence.quote: His Twin Fang and Bone Missle do decent damage on you, but you should be more concerned about Rip Earth which does big damage to Hero and Tristam.
If he uses Sleep Powder, one character will fall asleep, so make sure both are able to deal decent damage.
He's immune to poison and parylzing.

subject: Tristam
text: After Flamerus Rex is beaten, Tristam gives Hero the elixir.

evidence.quote: After you beat Flamerus Rex, the Sun Crystal will be restored, and Tristam will show off a really cool weapon (that you'll get later in the game.) He'll then give you the elixer

subject: Bone Dungeon
text: The chests after Flamerus Rex contain Potions, bombs, and the Sand Coin to open a door in Focus Tower.

evidence.quote: allow you to check the other chests, which contain Potions, bombs, and the Sand Coin, the key to a door in Focus Tower.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam leaves the party at the exit of the room where Flamerus Rex is fought.

evidence.quote: You'll be doing this alone though, because Tristam takes off, at the exit of the room you fight Flamerus Rex in.

subject: Kaeli
text: Giving Kaeli the elixir in the back room of her house leads her to tell you to visit Aquaria.

evidence.quote: Enter Kaeli's house, and go into th back room. You'll give Kaeli the elixer, and she'll tell you to you that you should visit Aquaria.

subject: Foresta
text: Using an axe to cut down trees in the south-east part of Foresta allows you to get more potions.

evidence.quote: now that you have an axe, you can also cut down some trees in the south-east part of town to get some more.

subject: Battlefield
text: The battlefield to the right of Sand Temple features Sand Worm and Minotaur Zombie enemies and gives a reward of 54 GP.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Sand Worm + Minotaur Zombie
Reward - 54 GP
To the right of Sand Temple, just before Focus Tower, is another battlefield.

subject: Cloaked Man
text: The cloaked man tells you to look for a girl named Phoebe and states Mac will play an important role.

evidence.quote: You'll meet your friend that cloaked man again, and he'll tell you to look for a girl named Phoebe, to join you on your quest, and as always. He also states "Mac" will play an important role in your quest, and he leaves without explaining it further.

subject: Focus Tower
text: Walking up the stairs leads to another floor where a treasure chest contains bombs.

evidence.quote: There are some stairs, walk up them, to reach another floor. Check the treasure chest, to get some more bombs, and then open the open the door with the sword on it.

subject: Focus Tower
text: A treasure chest to the south of the stairs contains the Fire spell.

evidence.quote: when you come out from another set of stairs, go left, and walk south. You'll see another treasure chest; This one has the Fire spell in it.

subject: Battlefield
text: The battlefield after Focus Tower features Mintmint enemies and awards 99 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Mintmint
Reward - 99 EXP

subject: Libra Temple
text: A chest in Libra Temple contains bombs.

evidence.quote: Check the chest to get some bombs, and then talk to the girl standing behind it.

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe joins the party after you talk to her in Libra Temple.

evidence.quote: And so, Phebe joins the party! You can leave the Libra Temple, after she joins.

subject: Battlefield
text: The battlefield to the right of Libra Temple features Giant Toad and Mintmint enemies and awards 300 GP.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Giant Toad + Mintmint
Reward - 300 GP
There is another battlefield to the right of Libra Temple.

subject: Scorpion
text: The Scorpion enemy is weak against Fire.

evidence.quote: You'll be facing a new type of enemy here, the Scorpion, and they are weak against Fire.

subject: Battlefield
text: Defeating 10 sets of enemies in the battlefield south of Aquaria rewards a Magic Ring, which raises defense by 3.

evidence.quote: Defeat 10 sets of enemies, and you'll be rewarded with a Magic Ring; An item that raises your defense by 3!

subject: Spencer
text: Freeing Spencer from the ice requires Wakewater, which requires finding the Libra Crest stolen by a monster in Wintry Cave.

evidence.quote: Phoebe will tell you her grandfather, Spencer, is trapped, and that you need to get Wakewater to melt the ice, and free him from the tunnel. To get that though, first you'll need the Libra Crest, which a monster in Wintry Cave stole.

subject: Aquaria
text: A chest in the first house on the left in Aquaria contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: There is a chest with Heal Potions in the house

subject: Aquaria
text: A chest in the house behind the first house contains Refreshers.

evidence.quote: there are some Refreshers in the house behind it, which you can reach by crossing the middle platform's bridges.

subject: Inn
text: Resting at the Inn in Aquaria costs 95 GP.

evidence.quote: There's also an Inn, where you can rest, to restore your health - for 95 GP.

subject: Steel Helm
text: A Steel Helm can be bought for 200 GP in the house in the north-west part of town.

evidence.quote: Also, you'll want to pick up a Steel Helm for 200 GP, in the house in the north-west part of the town.

subject: Battlefield

evidence.quote: To the east of Aquaria is yet another Battlefield.

subject: Wintry Cave

evidence.quote: When you enter, there is a Scorpion, and an edgehog, on the left, blocking a chest with exlosives in it.

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe gives Hero the Cat Claw and switches her weapon to the Bow and Arrows.

evidence.quote: After seeing this, she'll give you the Cat Claw, and switch her own weapon to the Bow and Arrows.

subject: Cat Claw

evidence.quote: Now you'll be able to climb up walls with the hand grips on them, as well as use it in battle.

subject: Wintry Cave

evidence.quote: There's a Land Worm, and a Centaur on the right, who block a chest with three potions inside.

subject: Wintry Cave
text: Beyond the barricaded doorway, two treasure chests contain potions and arrows.

text: Fighting to the right from the entrance of the room reveals two chests containing arrows and potions.

subject: Wintry Cave
text: In the bottom of the room, two chests contain Arrows and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: In the bottom of this area, two chests, containing Arrows and Heal Potions.

subject: Wintry Cave
text: The chest on the center platform under the ice contains arrows.

evidence.quote: reach the platform in the middle of the room (the chest contains arrows.)

subject: Flamerus Rex
text: Hero should bomb Flamerus Rex every turn or use Quake, while Tristam uses Ninja Stars, using Life if either Tristam or Hero need healing.

evidence.quote: Have Hero bomb him...every turn - Or you could use Quake, which is better...until you run out of it. Use Tristam's Ninja Stars,...using Life if either Tristam, or Hero need healing.
